summary: Senior frontend engineer with 15+ years of experience building scalable, high-performance web applications and frontend platforms. Expertise in JavaScript, TypeScript, and modern build tooling, with a strong focus on performance optimization, accessibility (WCAG), and scalable component architectures. Proven leader who mentors engineers, drives engineering best practices, and delivers responsive, enterprise-grade applications for global organizations including Google, Amazon, and Johnson & Johnson. Increasingly focused on applying AI-assisted development workflows (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Gemini Code Assist) to accelerate delivery without sacrificing quality.

Implemented markdown parsing and citation-rendering logic to present sourced, readable answers to end users.
